Law (muloiwa_2020_free_laws eq 15):
  \mu=\mu_{max}\left[1-\frac{X}{X_{m}}\right]
  as transcribed: mu = mumax*(1-X/Xm)
Law variables to map:
  X: Biomass concentration [?]
  mu: Specific bacteria growth rate [1 / s]   <- the quantity the law computes
Law parameters (not mapped): Xm, mumax

Model symbols (the rate symbol is r):
  r: specific rate in the biomass and substrate balance equations [1 / h]
  u1: dilution factor [1 / h]
  u2: substrate concentration in the feed [g / l]
  x1: measured concentration [g / l]
  x2: substrate concentration [g / l]

answer.note: X maps to x1, the measured concentration; x2 is explicitly substrate concentration. The law's specific growth rate mu maps to the model rate r. Their stated time units differ (1/s versus 1/h), so convert units when using the law.
